## Summary

Describe the problem and the change. Link a related issue when there is one.

## Verification

List the commands run and their results. Include relevant tests and any checks that were skipped, with the reason.

## Compatibility and security

Describe changes to native Claude forwarding, the Codex adapter, credentials, platform support, or release/install behavior. Write "No changes" if none apply.

## Checklist

- [ ] Relevant tests cover the changed behavior and pass.
- [ ] Typecheck, lint, and formatting checks pass, or failures are explained above.
- [ ] CLI, configuration, and workflow changes are documented where needed.
- [ ] No credentials, auth files, private prompts, or real request captures are included.
- [ ] Tests use local stubs and synthetic data, not real-account access.
